facts.statement: Free Realms ran a Summer Kick-Off Sale with hot deals and cool prices from May 25 to May 27, 2013.
facts.quote: Hot deals, Cool Prices! May 25th – May 27th*

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A short freerealms.com promotional post announcing the Summer Kick-Off Sale, valid May 25-27, 2013 (PDT), advertising Parachutes and Station Cash stock-up deals. The page gives no prices or item lists, and the posting date is not shown beyond a relative 'Posted 1 month, 6 days ago' label, so the exact post date is unknown.
